previous_statement: For every compact C^1 manifold M (equivalently, a class-one manifold in the terminology of GT-cairns-1935-theorem-p549), M is covered by the domains of a finite set of allowable coordinate systems.
new_statement: If M is a compact C^1 manifold equipped with an atlas A whose coordinate systems are allowable in the Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead sense, then M is covered by the domains of a finite set of allowable coordinate systems.
